ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB Twin Edge Graphics Card

Maximize your desktop layout's potential with the next-generation ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB Twin Edge graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by NVIDIA's cutting-edge high-efficiency architecture, this compact powerhouse features 8GB of ultra-fast dedicated memory layout to push frame rates to the limit at high resolutions. The aerodynamic Twin Edge dual-fan design features an enhanced IceStorm thermal cooling matrix, specifically engineered to deliver maximum airflow and heat dissipation while maintaining an exceptionally small footprint that fits effortlessly into standard SFF PC chassis. Outfitted with a rigid metal backplate to ensure structural durability and factory-tuned for premium power efficiency, this powerful mainstream GPU infrastructure is backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
